other_failure_modes.name: Feature engineering before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent applies feature engineering techniques (such as frequency encoding and group aggregations) on the combined training and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the distribution and statistics of the test set into the training features, leading to overly optimistic cross-validation scores.

summary: The agent demonstrates a robust machine learning pipeline with cross-validation, diverse models, target encoding, and post-processing. However, a critical flaw exists in the preprocessing phase: imputation, frequency encoding, and group-based feature engineering are all performed on the combined train and test dataset, causing severe data leakage. Additionally, the agent only evaluates the model using a single metric (RMSE).
